title: 바라는 것: 바라다, 원하다, 소원
objective: By the end, you can use words such as 바라다, 원하다, 희망, 소원 and 바람 to say what you or other people wish for in short sentences.
summary: Learn ten everyday words for talking about wishes, hopes and dreams in Korean.

task.title: Use the wish words
task.line: Read each sentence, then choose, write or change the word so it fits the sentence.

words.meaning: to hope (that something good happens); often used as -기를 바라요 'I hope that ...' (to say you want a thing or a choice, use 원하다)
words.exampleMeaning: I hope everyone in my family stays healthy.

words.meaning: to want (a thing or a choice)
hope (a chance that things will go well)
words.exampleMeaning: The test was hard, but there is still hope.

words.meaning: a wish (something you really want to happen)
words.exampleMeaning: What is your New Year's wish?

words.meaning: a wish or hope (what someone wishes for); the same word also means 'wind'
words.example: 제 바람은 우리 아이가 행복하게 사는 거예요.
words.exampleMeaning: My wish is for my child to live happily.

words.meaning: a dream (a goal for your life)
words.exampleMeaning: What was your dream when you were a child?

words.meaning: to make (a wish); used as 소원을 빌다
words.exampleMeaning: I made a wish in front of my birthday cake.

words.meaning: to come true (a wish or dream)
words.exampleMeaning: I practiced hard, so my dream came true.
Happy New Year. (lit. Receive a lot of luck in the new year.)

words.meaning: really, for sure (adds strong wish or will)
words.exampleMeaning: Next time, I really want to pass.

exercises: Choose the right word (hint: 원하다 = want a thing or a choice for yourself; 바라다 = hope that something good happens, as in -기를 바라다): ① 손님, (원하는 / 바라는) 자리에 앉으세요. ② 시험에 꼭 합격하시기를 (바랍니다 / 원합니다).
Fill in the blank with 빌다 in the past tense (-었어요): 보름달을 보면서 소원을 ____.
Fill in the blank with 이루어지다 in the past tense (-었어요): 열 살 때부터 바란 소원이 드디어 ____.
What does 바람 mean in each sentence? Write wind or wish: ① 오늘은 바람이 많이 불어요. ② 부모님의 바람은 제가 건강하게 지내는 거예요.
Fill in each blank with 꼭, 새해, or 희망 (use each word once): ① ____에는 운동을 시작할 거예요. ② 내일 모임에 ____ 오세요. ③ 포기하지 마세요. 아직 ____이 있어요.
Answer in Korean in one sentence: 소원이 뭐예요?
answers: ① 새해 ② 꼭 ③ 희망
Sample answer: 제 소원은 가족과 같이 사는 거예요. (Any sentence in the form 제 소원은 ~ 거예요 / ~(이)에요 is correct.)
